      "name": "ipc",

      "evidence": "Updates src/node/interfaces.cpp and test/functional/interface_ipc_cli.py to resolve an IPC-specific error-handling bug.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a concrete issue for IPC clients where empty HTTP bodies resulted in JSON type errors instead of permission errors. As noted in the description, 'bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect receives only the response body, so a refused call prints a JSON type error instead of a permission error', fixing a gap identified in a private security review."
    },

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "This PR has no connection to mining or block generation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies src/httprpc.cpp, src/rpc/request.cpp, and src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to return structured JSON-RPC errors for whitelist rejections.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects non-compliant empty HTTP 403 responses on whitelist denials by returning structured JSON-RPC error codes. The description cites doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md requirements that failed calls report structured JSON-RPC errors, and introduces RPC_METHOD_NOT_PERMITTED (-38) and RPC_REQUEST_NOT_EXECUTED (-39) while fixing error checking in bitcoin-cli -generate."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",

      "rationale": "Edits in wallet files are purely mechanical call-site adjustments following the extraction of client connection state."
    }
